en: An ornate, early‑20th‑century postcard with four photographic portraits of monarchs in circular frames surrounded by richly decorated floral and interlaced patterns and numerous crowned heraldic shields of various Slavic states and regions. The central upper portrait is of a bearded emperor in military uniform; three other rulers are depicted beneath. At the top right is the year "1910". The design is in red, gold, blue, and green, with Cyrillic text in a decorative panel at the bottom.
